y-m-55-02.title: Ukulawula izimpande zika-x²+kx+4=0 ngo-k
y-m-55-02.topic: Inani nezimpawu zezimpande ezingempela zesibalo se-quadratic
y-m-55-02.goal: Hlola, ngokwenza izibonelo, ukuthi esibalweni se-quadratic esiqukethe uhlamvu u-k inani nezimpawu zezimpande ezingempela zishintsha ngenani luka-k, futhi uchaze ngezinombolo ukuthi kungani u-k ophozithivu engasebenzi.
y-m-55-02.material: U-k uyinombolo engaguquki engempela, futhi izixazululo zesibalo u-x²+kx+4=0 (x squared plus k times x plus 4 equals 0) zibhekwa phakathi kwezinombolo ezingempela kuphela. Uma ushintsha u-k, inani nezimpawu zezixazululo ezingempela ziyashintsha.
y-m-55-02.thinking.1: Ukwenza izibonelo eziningana ezanelisa isimo (izimpande ezimbili ezingempela ezihlukile ezifozithivu)
y-m-55-02.thinking.2: Ukuchaza ngezibonelo zezinombolo ukuthi kungani isimo sidingeka
y-m-55-02.prereq.0: Incazelo yezimpande (izixazululo) zesibalo se-quadratic nesipiliyoni sokwenza izici zezisho zefomu u-x²+px+q (izinga lesikole esiphakathi)
y-m-55-02.prereq.1: Isipiliyoni sokwelula isikwele esiphelele u-(x+2)² = x²+4x+4
y-m-55-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha wonke ama-k lapho lesi sibalo sinesixazululo esisodwa ngqo esingempela.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.hint.0: Uqala ngamanani amancane njengo-k = 0, 2, faka amanani ambalwa ku-x futhi uhlole ukuthi u-x²+kx+4 ungaba ngu-0 yini.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi inani elincane kakhulu lesisho kumele libe yini ukuze igrafu ithinte nje i-x-axis, futhi uphinde ubhale u-x²+kx+4 ngefomu u-(x+k/2)² + (…) futhi uveze leli nani ngo-k.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.a: Ku-x²+4=0, u-x² kumele abe negethivu, ngakho akukho sixazululo esingempela nhlobo. Bheka futhi ukuthi isixazululo esisodwa sivela nini.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu ukucabanga okuzama ukubhala kabusha isisho ngefomu lesikwele esiphelele.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.c: Njengo-x²+2x+4 = (x+1)²+3, uhlala ephozithivu, ngakho akukho sixazululo. Isixazululo asivami ngoba nje u-k engesiyo u-0.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu ukucabanga okubheke u-k onophawu oluphambene ngendlela efanayo.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.e: Kulula ukucabanga ukuthi okukhulu u-k, izixazululo ziningi. U-x²+8x+4=0 unezixazululo ezingempela ezimbili ezihlukile.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.explain: Uma u-k=4, bese u-x²+4x+4 = (x+2)², futhi uma u-k=−4, bese u-x²−4x+4 = (x−2)², ngakho kunesixazululo esisodwa (isixazululo esiphindaphindwayo). Ku-k=0 no-k=2 akukho sixazululo, futhi ku-k=8 kunezixazululo ezimbili ezihlukile.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.prompt: Faka izinombolo eziphelele ezingu-3 ezihlukile u-k lapho u-x²+kx+4=0 unezixazululo ezimbili ezingempela ezihlukile eziphozithivu.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.hint.0: Lungisa u-k oyedwa, xazulula u-x²+kx+4=0 ngqo, futhi uhlole ukuthi izixazululo ezimbili ezihlukile ziyaphuma yini.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.hint.1: Uma uthole izixazululo, bheka izimpawu ukubona ukuthi zombili ziphozithivu yini, uma kungenjalo, shintsha uphawu luka-k futhi uhlole futhi.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Sicela wenze u-k abe yinombolo ephelele.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Aziphenduki zibe izixazululo ezimbili ezingempela ezihlukile. Akukho sixazululo noma kunesisodwa. Bheka futhi eduze kwenani lomkhawulo.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Zombili izixazululo aziphozithivu. Hlola izimpawu zezixazululo ngqo.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, uma u-k=−5, bese u-x²−5x+4 = (x−1)(x−4), ngakho izixazululo ziyi-1 no-4. Ku-k=−4 kunesixazululo esisodwa (2), futhi ku-k=5 izixazululo zingu--1 no--4, zombili zinegethivu. Ukuze kwanelise kokubili uphawu nenani, u-k kumele abe ngaphansi kuka--4.
y-m-55-02.s.s3.prompt: Kungani izixazululo zombili zingeke zibe iphozithivu ku-k ophozithivu onjengo-k = 5? Chaza usebenzisa izinombolo.
y-m-55-02.s.s3.hint.0: Xazulula x²+5x+4=0 ngqo ngo-k=5 bese ubhala izimpawu zezixazululo ezimbili.
y-m-55-02.s.s3.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi uphawu lwenkathi ngayinye ye-x²+5x+4 luyini uma ufaka izinombolo eziphozithivu kuphela ku-x.
y-m-55-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe izixazululo zangempela zibalwe esibonelweni sezinombolo engasinikeza?
y-m-55-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ngishilo 'ukuthi kungani kuhlala kunjalo uma k iyiphozithivu' njengesizathu hhayi ngesibonelo esisodwa kuphela?

y-m-55-01.material: UHyunwoo waxazulula isibalo u-x/(x−2) = 2/(x−2). (Indlela yokufunda: "x phezu kuka-(x ukhiphe 2) kulingana no-2 phezu kuka-(x ukhiphe 2)." U-x uyinombolo engempela.) UHyunwoo wathi, "U-x=2 uyisixazululo. Angicabangi ukuthi ngidinga ukuhlola."
y-m-55-01.thinking.0: Ukuthola ukuthi umugqa ngamunye wesixazululo unesimo esifihliwe yini
y-m-55-01.thinking.1: Ukuhlola ngokuhlukile ukuthi inani elitholwe liwumuntu angaba nguye kuphela noma liyisixazululo ngempela
y-m-55-01.thinking.2: Ukusho isiphetho ('asikho isixazululo') kanye nobufakazi baso
y-m-55-01.prereq.0: Ukuthi esishweni sengxenyana inani alichazwanga uma okuhlukanisayo kungu-0 (izinga lesikole esiphakathi)

Indlela ye-Basic Math 1 yesikole esiphakeme ibhekwa njengezinga lokubuyekeza izinombolo eziyisisekelo, izisho, nezibalo, futhi ukufunda okudingekayo okungezansi kucatshangwa ukuthi sekufundiwe kakade.
y-m-55-01.s.s1.prompt: Kwenzekani uma ufaka impendulo kaHyeonu u-x=2 ngqo endaweni luka-x esishweni sokuqala u-x/(x−2) = 2/(x−2)?
y-m-55-01.s.s1.hint.0: Faka u-2 endaweni luka-x futhi uqale ubale ukuthi okuhlukanisayo u-x−2 kuba yini.
y-m-55-01.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenza ukuthi ingxenyana inomqondo uma okuhlukanisayo kwayo kungaleli nani.
y-m-55-01.s.s1.o.a: Izinhlangothi zombili ziba yinani elifanayo, ngakho isibalo siyasebenza
y-m-55-01.s.s1.r.a: Uthathe izinhlangothi zombili ukuba nefomu elifanayo njengokuba nenani. Hlola inani lokuhlukanisayo kuqala.
y-m-55-01.s.s1.o.b: Okuhlukanisayo u-x−2 kuba ngu-0, ngakho amanani ezinhlangothi zombili awachazwanga
y-m-55-01.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu ukucabanga okuqala kuhlola ukuthi inani lesisho likhona yini.
y-m-55-01.s.s1.o.c: Izinhlangothi zombili ziba ngu-0, ngakho u-0=0 uyasebenza
y-m-55-01.s.s1.r.c: Kungenzeka uxubanise u-x lapho inombolo ephezulu ingu-0 no-x lapho okuhlukanisayo kungu-0. Uma u-x=2, inombolo ephezulu ingu-2.
y-m-55-01.s.s1.o.d: Uhlangothi lwesobunxele luba ngu-0 futhi uhlangothi lwesokudla luba ngu-1, ngakho ahlukile
y-m-55-01.s.s1.r.d: Uzamile ukuphatha ingxenyana enokuhlukanisayo okungu-0 njengenye inombolo. Inani elihlukaniswe ngo-0 alichazwanga.
y-m-55-01.s.s1.explain: Uma ufaka u-x=2, okuhlukanisayo u-x−2 kuba ngu-0, ngakho akukho uhlangothi lwesobunxele noma lwesokudla olunenani elichaziwe. Ngakho awukwazi ukusho 'izinhlangothi zombili ziyalingana,' futhi u-2 akamukelwa njengesixazululo.
y-m-55-01.s.s2.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa ophosile esixazululweni sikaHyeonu.
y-m-55-01.s.s2.hint.0: Eceleni kwalo mugqa ngamunye, bhala ukuthi likhona yini 'isimo lapho ungakwenza lokhu.'
y-m-55-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi isisho u-x−2 esisetshenziswe emgqeni 1 siba ngu-0 kuma-x muni.
y-m-55-01.s.s2.explain: Umugqa 1 wenze inguquko engenziwa kuphela uma u-x−2 engesiyo u-0, kodwa wayenza ngaphandle kwesimo. Umugqa 3 wabiza inani elitholwe ngokuthi isixazululo ngaphandle kokuhlola ukuthi lanelisa yini isimo sokuqala (okuhlukanisayo akusiyo u-0). Umugqa 2 ulungile njengokubala uma ulandela umugqa 1. Inkinga akuyona ukubala kodwa ukuthi isimo esivumela inguquko nokuhlola kokugcina kwashiywa.
y-m-55-01.s.s3.prompt: Isibalo sinezixazululo ezingempela ezingaki? Futhi ubhale ukuthi ungatshela uHyeonu ukuthi abhale ini kuqala lapho eqala isixazululo.
y-m-55-01.s.s3.hint.0: Phatha ngqo, njengesiphetho, umphumela wokufaka esishweni sokuqala ngemuva kokuthi impendulo iphume.
y-m-55-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ngaphambi kokuqala isixazululo, qala ubhale ukuthi likhona yini inani u-x angasenakulithatha.
y-m-55-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Isiphetho sami (inani lezixazululo) sihambisana nomphumela wokufaka u-x=2 esishweni sokuqala?
y-m-55-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ucabange ukuthi isiphetho singahluka kanjani uma izinhlangothi zombili bezingesisho esifanayo ngqo u-x/(x−2)?
y-m-55-01.s.s3.model.0: U-x=2, owenza okuhlukanisayo u-x−2 kube ngu-0, akakwazi ukusetshenziswa. Ngakho uma uqala ubhale isimo sokuthi u-x akasiyo u-2 bese uxazulula, uthola u-x=2, ophikisana nesimo. Ngakho asikho isixazululo.
y-m-55-01.s.s3.model.1: Uma ngifaka u-x=2, okuhlukanisayo kwezinhlangothi zombili kuba ngu-0, ngakho akusebenzi. Khona-ke asikho isixazululo. Uma ubhala u-x≠2 kuqala ngaphambi kokuphindaphinda, ungavimbela lolu hlobo lwephutha.
y-m-55-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Isixazululo esifushane esishiwo ngaphandle kwethebula nasso sanele.
y-m-55-01.s.s3.model.2: Asikho isixazululo. Kuqala kufanele sibhale ukuthi inani elenza u-x−2 alingane no-0 alikwazi ukusetshenziswa.

y-m-55-09.title: Singabhala nini u-(a+b)² njenge-a²+b²?
y-m-55-09.goal: Hlola iphutha lokukholelwa ukuthi isisho esihloliwe ngamanani amabili noma amabili sihlala sibamba, bese wenza izibonelo ukuhlola ukuthi umehluko phakathi kuka-(a+b)² no-a²+b² uvezwa kanjani nokuthi uba ngu-0 nini.
y-m-55-09.material: UDaeun ucabanga u-(a+b)² = a²+b². (Indlela yokufunda: 'the square of a plus b equals a squared plus b squared.') Lapho ehlola ngokufaka a=3, b=0, (3+0)²=9 no-3²+0²=9, ngakho kwakulungile. Cabanga, ngamagama kuphela, ngesithombe lapho isikwele esikhulu esinohlangothi a+b sihlukaniswe saba yisikwele esisodwa esinohlangothi a, isikwele esisodwa esinohlangothi b, nezikwele ezinde ezimbili ezinobubanzi a nobude b.
y-m-55-09.thinking.0: Ukuhlola ukuthi isibonelo esisetshenzisiwe ekuhloleni sijwayelekile kangakanani
y-m-55-09.thinking.1: Ukwenza izibonelo eziningana ezanelisa isimo (umehluko ungu-12)
y-m-55-09.prereq.0: Ukuthola inani lesisho ngokufaka izinombolo esikhundleni sezinhlamvu (ibanga lesikole esiphakathi)
y-m-55-09.prereq.1: Imodeli yendawo: isipiliyoni sokuhlukanisa isikwele esinohlangothi a+b sibe yisikwele esisodwa ngasinye esinezinhlangothi a no-b nezikwele ezinde ezimbili ezinobubanzi a nobude b
y-m-55-09.s.s1.prompt: Kufanele sihlole kanjani ukuhlola kukaDaeun (a=3, b=0)?

y-m-55-09.s.s1.o.b: Ukubala kuphumile kulungile, ngakho kuyibufakazi obanele bokuthi isisho sihlala sibamba

y-m-55-09.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu ukucabanga okukhulume ngazo zonke izinombolo eziphozithivu kusuka kunani elilodwa. Zama ukufaka ezinye izinombolo eziphozithivu ukuhlola.
y-m-55-09.s.s1.explain: Uma b=0, zonke izinkathi eziqukethe b ziyanyamalala, ngakho noma isisho esingalungile singenzeka silunge. Isibonelo esisodwa asiqinisekisi 'njalo.' Lesi sibonelo sinikeza kuphela ulwazi lokuthi kukhona izimo lapho silungile khona.
